//// own/holes/bidi_arg_lazy.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
struct node { int v; struct node *_Owned _Nullable next; };
struct list { struct node *_Owned _Nullable head; };
static struct node *_Owned mk(int v) { struct node *_Owned _Nullable n = calloc(1, sizeof *n); if (!n) exit(1); n->v = v; return n; }
static int *_Owned mki(int v) { int *_Owned _Nullable n = calloc(1, sizeof *n); if (!n) exit(1); *n = v; return n; }
static void drop(struct node *_Owned n) { free(n); }
static void clear(struct list *l) { while (l->head) { struct node *_Owned _Nullable n = _Take(l->head); if (!n) return; l->head = _Take(n->next); free(n); } }
static void use(int x) { printf("%d\n", x); }
struct X{int*_Static _Nullable __bidi_indexable p;}; static int f(int*_Nullable __bidi_indexable a,int k){return a?a[0]+k:0;} static int gg;
static int kill(struct X*_Owned x){free(x);return 1;}
int main(){struct X*_Owned _Nullable x=calloc(1,sizeof*x); if(!x)return 1; x->p=&gg; use(f(x->p,kill(x)));}

//// own/holes/bidi_field_assign_order.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
/* Codegen computes a __bidi_indexable destination's address before the right
   side; ClangIR (what is checked) evaluates the right side first. */
struct N { int *_Owned _Nullable __bidi_indexable f; };
struct V { long a[3]; };
struct W { struct N *_Owned _Nullable k; struct V *_Owned _Nullable v; };
static int *_Owned _Nullable g(struct W *w) {
  free(_Take(w->k));
  w->v = calloc(1, sizeof(struct V)); /* takes the freed slot */
  w->k = calloc(1, sizeof(struct N));
  return calloc(1, 4);
}
int main() {
  struct W w = {0};
  w.k = calloc(1, sizeof(struct N));
  if (!w.k) return 1;
  w.k->f = g(&w); /* writes 24 bytes to the freed old w.k */
  if (w.v) printf("victim %lx (must be 0)\n", w.v->a[0]);
}

//// own/holes/index_pointer_order.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
/* i[p]: codegen loads p before evaluating i; ClangIR (what is checked) the other way. */
struct G { int a[4]; };
struct V { int a[4]; };
struct X { struct G *_Owned _Nullable s; struct V *_Owned _Nullable v; };
static int rx(struct X *x) {
  free(_Take(x->s));
  x->v = calloc(1, sizeof(struct V)); /* takes the freed slot */
  x->s = calloc(1, sizeof(struct G));
  return 0;
}
int main() {
  struct X x = {0};
  x.s = calloc(1, sizeof(struct G));
  if (!x.s) return 1;
  rx(&x)[x.s->a] = 41; /* writes to the freed old x.s */
  if (x.v) printf("victim %d (must be 0)\n", x.v->a[0]);
}

//// own/holes/ptr_plus_index_order.c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
struct node { int v; struct node *_Owned _Nullable next; };
struct list { struct node *_Owned _Nullable head; };
static struct node *_Owned mk(int v) { struct node *_Owned _Nullable n = calloc(1, sizeof *n); if (!n) exit(1); n->v = v; return n; }
static int *_Owned mki(int v) { int *_Owned _Nullable n = calloc(1, sizeof *n); if (!n) exit(1); *n = v; return n; }
static void drop(struct node *_Owned n) { free(n); }
static void clear(struct list *l) { while (l->head) { struct node *_Owned _Nullable n = _Take(l->head); if (!n) return; l->head = _Take(n->next); free(n); } }
static void use(int x) { printf("%d\n", x); }
static int gg[4]; struct X{int*_Static __counted_by(4) p; long pad[4];}; static int kill(struct X*_Owned x){free(x);return 1;}
int main(){struct X*_Owned _Nullable x=calloc(1,sizeof*x); if(!x)return 1; x->p=gg; use(*(x->p+kill(x)));}

}
